decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - This permission shall be for a limited period only expiring 30th June 2011 or in the event of implementation occuring later (as set out in Condition 1), after a period of 5 years from the date of implementation, when the use shall be discontinued.

Condition : 4 - No amplified music or amplified speech shall be played on the premises at a level which would be audible from outside the boundary of the premises. No noise generated from non-amplified sources shall be audible from outside the boundary of the premises.
Condition : 5 - The use herby permitted for D1 non-residential education and training purposes shall only operate between the hours of 7.00 a.m. and 9.00 p.m.

Condition : 6 - The application Unit No. G01D, of the Barley Mow Centre, Barley Mow Passage, shall be used as a non-residential and training centre for the education and training of adults and for no other purpose within Class D1 Non-Residential Institutions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, including any purpose for the education of children, or as an office in accordance with Class B1 (Business) (a) of the Order and for no other B1 purpose.
description: Planning permission to delete Condition 1 (limited period of one year) and to amend Condition 3 (no music shall be played) and Condition 4 (the hours between 7am and 8 pm) attached to approved planning permission (change of use from office (B1a) to education and training centre (D1) reference 00074/10/P4 dated 16/02/2006
